When you are clearing a particularly cluttered space, clear a table top or similar area in the room. It's important that the space is in the room, because then you won't waste time and energy going back in and out of the room. Also, it's important that it's a distinct space. Pulling out chunks and placing them in the staging area lets you focus on what's in front of you. Sorting out things where they lie, in their element, can make it hard to break the inertia; "Well, I mean this has been fine really so it's ok if I just leave this as is." Remember, you set out to clean the space, not settle!

To set this space up, its ok to pile stuff wherever - you will get to it later - just try not to make it too messy, as that may demoralize you. When you bring items to this area, bring enough so that you will be standing / sitting for at least 5 minutes at a time, preferably longer. The less you move around the more tie you have to think, review what you have, and come up with organizing solutions that work for you.
Organizing Tip of the Day (2015.01.07) - Get a staging area
